DHL Air (Austria) GmbH is a cargo airline founded in 2021 and a proud subsidiary of the DHL Group. Our primary focus is operating within the European network with a modern fleet of Boeing 757 and 767 aircraft.

Our headquarter is located in Vienna, with our main crew base in Leipzig, where we deliver on our customer promise: Excellence. Simply Delivered.

Would you like to be part of the world's most international company?

Join a company that pioneered cross-border express delivery in ... 1 Ground Safety Expert (m/f/d) Your Responsibility:
As Ground Safety Expert you`ll own risk management and assurance processes across ground safety, including dangerous goods. You will investigate occurrences, support Safety Risk Evaluations, maintain our Ground Operations hazards register and work closely with Ground Operations, Austro Control and DHL group airlines to keep our ground and cargo operations safe. Reporting to the Senior Supervisor Safety, you will play a visible, hands-on role in a Just Culture safety environment where your analysis and recommendations directly inform how we manage risks.

Your Tasks:
 * Coordinate, investigate and manage ground safety investigations and occurrence reports, assessing risk, identifying root causes and recommending corrective and preventative actions.
 * Prepare, coordinate and facilitate the Ground Safety Action Group and contribute to the Safety Review Board.
 * Maintain and develop the Ground Operations hazard register in close partnership with Ground Operations.
 * Support risk assessments of occurrence reports and contribute to Safety Risk Evaluations on ground safety topics.
 * Own the administration and control of ground safety related reports, SPIs and statistics - spotting trends and following them up with the right people.
 * Represent DHA on ground safety matters with external stakeholders such as Austro Control and DHL group airlines.
 * Be accountable for the quality, integrity and regulatory compliance of the risk data and recommendations you produce, in line with IOSA ISARPs and DHA standards.

Your Qualifications:
 * An undergraduate degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.
 * 5 years of relevant work experience, including at least 2 years in the aeronautical industry.
 * A dangerous goods training certificate - CAT 10 or similar competency-based DG training preferred.
 * Solid experience with risk management and assurance processes in aviation and familiarity with management systems.
 * Working knowledge of EU aviation safety regulations, AOC operations specifications and operations manual requirements.
 * A sound grasp of statistical principles and confidence working with data and trends.
 * Fluent in English, strong MS Office skills and the interpersonal skills to build effective relationships across the business.
 * The ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities and stay composed under pressure.

We Offer:
 * Exciting career opportunities in a dynamic, international aviation environment
 * A modern, newly designed office located directly at Vienna Airport with excellent public transport connections
 * Attractive employee benefits, including airport shopping discounts, access to myID travel, corporate benefits, supported KlimaTicket or parking options, Edenred vouchers, and much more.
 * For this roles, we offer a competitive minimum gross salary of € 4,623 based on full-time employment with the possibility of an adjusted salary depending on your experience and qualification. 
 * In addition, we offer an attractive company bonus scheme.
 * This position is initially offered on a two-year fixed-term contract, with the possibility of transitioning to a permanent position thereafter.

Welcome to Auvaria, where passion, team spirit, responsibility and courage form the basis of our culture. We are an AWS consulting and engineering partner helping clients modernize and migrate their workloads to the cloud: pragmatically, securely and at scale.

Containers & Cloud-Native Workloads

 * Migrate and operate containerized workloads using Kubernetes (EKS) or ECS/Fargate

Customer Collaboration

 * Act as a trusted technical counterpart for customer teams

This way, you can realise your full potential and strengthen the entire team at the same time!

Nice to have

 * AWS certifications 
 * Database migration experience

jobs.description:
1 Lab Lead, BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs (all genders) Innovation Ecosystem & Strategic Partnerships

 * You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE Labs nationally and internationally within the innovation ecosystem - universities, research institutions, public organizations, start-ups, and technology partners.
 * You act as a key contact for strategic collaborations and help identify opportunities for joint innovation and research initiatives.
 * You represent BIG BLUE MARBLE at conferences, workshops, exhibitions, and industry events, expanding our professional network and visibility.
 * You contribute to strategic initiatives across the organization, supporting new partnerships and innovation opportunities.

Knowledge Transfer & Innovation Communication

 * You ensure innovation outcomes are communicated effectively, internally and externally.
 * You support the creation of technical blogs, conference papers, exhibition contributions, presentations, and other dissemination formats.
 * You prepare management-ready summaries, technology assessments, and recommendations based on PoC results and emerging technology trends.
 * You promote knowledge sharing across teams and help translate innovation into long-term business value.

Your background:
 * A technical foundation, not necessarily a management CV. You have worked as a (Full Stack) Software Developer, Engineer, or in a comparable hands-on technical role - and you understand modern software development, cloud technologies, and digital platforms from the inside.
 * A Bachelor's degree (or higher) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a comparable technical discipline - helpful for writing well-founded technical papers and conference contributions. Equivalent professional experience is welcome in place of a formal degree.
 * A genuine wish to change direction: you're ready to trade day-to-day coding for coordinating people, representing the company externally, and shaping innovation strategy. Prior exposure to project or product coordination is a plus, not a requirement.
 * Streaming and broadcast media know-how is very welcome - but if you bring strong technical fundamentals, we're confident you can build this knowledge quickly on the job.
 * You're comfortable presenting, networking, and representing BIG BLUE MARBLE confidently in front of external audiences - at conferences, workshops, and partner meetings.
 * You enjoy structuring ambiguous, early-stage ideas, coordinating people across disciplines, and turning promising concepts into tangible outcomes.
 * Experience contributing to technical blogs, conference papers, white papers, or presentations is a strong asset.
 * Comfortable working in agile environments and facilitating sprint-based collaboration.
 * Experience with universities, research institutions, start-ups, or technology partners is a plus.
